scenes.title: Past Life · The Borrowed Pen
scenes.summary: In her past life, before the final NAC exam, Shen Man asks Lin Zhixia to lend her a pen. Lin hands one over without thinking. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second.
scenes.text: Before the final NAC Comprehensive Aptitude Test. Outside the exam hall. Lin Zhixia is silently reciting formulas. Shen Man walks up: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine just ran dry." Lin Zhixia pulls one from her pencil case and hands it over. Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper, and gives it back: "Thanks. This one writes nice." Lin Zhixia doesn't think twice. She doesn't see it — when Shen Man returns the pen, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second.

scenes.title: Past Life · Score Night
scenes.summary: In her past life on NAC score night, Lin Zhixia sees 487. Her score review is denied. Shen Man tops the national ranking with 669, the blue mark on her palm fading.
scenes.text: Late night. The NAC website releases scores. Lin Zhixia refreshes the page a dozen times. Finally the screen flashes: "487." Her hands start shaking. Her mother leans over to look, then her legs give out and she drops into a chair. Her teacher Old Chen is stunned on the phone: "Impossible. I've taught for twenty years... I'll file a score review with the NAC Committee right now." Three days later, the review is denied. The reply is four words: Score is correct. Meanwhile, Shen Man tops the NAC national ranking with "669." In an interview she says, "I just performed above my usual level" — then her eyes go blank for a second. She glances down at the hand that took the pen: a faint blue mark on her palm, fading. The comments flood in: "Rich AND hardworking."

scenes.title: Past Life · The Rooftop
scenes.summary: In her past life on College Commitment Day, Shen Man admits on the rooftop that she swapped scores — then pushes Lin Zhixia off, staging it as a suicide.
scenes.text: The day of the College Commitment deadline. An anonymous text lures her to the rooftop. Shen Man drops all pretense: "You think I got here on my dad? That three million was to buy off the score review. The swap — I did that myself." Lin Zhixia: "You?" Shen Man holds out her hand. The blue mark on her palm is almost invisible now: "That pen of yours. It wrote real nice. Guess why I had to borrow yours?" Lin Zhixia turns to leave — to report it, to call the police. Footsteps close in behind her. Two hands slam into her back. As the wind rushes past, Shen Man's voice drifts down from the rooftop edge: "Next life, don't lend your pen to just anyone." What the world called a suicide was a murder from start to finish.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Switch
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia wakes on the first morning of the NAC finals. She writes three rules and places Zhou Yu's forgotten pen in the outer pocket of her pencil case.
scenes.text: She opens her eyes. It's the first morning of the NAC National Academic Championship finals. The contestant badge on the desk, her mother's porridge by the door, the date on her phone — exactly as she remembers. Lin Zhixia pinches the back of her hand. It hurts. She sits for ten minutes, then writes three lines in her notebook: "One — she borrows the pen to swap scores. The pen is the anchor. Two — don't lend her my pen. Three — that push on the rooftop? This time she hits air. And I record it." She closes the notebook and checks her pencil case: her own pen, a backup, and one Zhou Yu left on her desk last week. She slides Zhou Yu's pen into the outer pocket.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Final Exam
scenes.summary: Before the final NAC test, Shen Man borrows a pen again. Lin Zhixia hands her Zhou Yu's pen. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip lingers for half a second — just like before.
scenes.text: Before the final NAC Comprehensive Aptitude Test. Shen Man sidles up, just as expected: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine ran dry." Lin Zhixia smiles and pulls the pen from the outer pocket: "Here." Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper. Lin Zhixia notices her grip is strange — like she's feeling for something. When she returns it, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second. Exactly like last time. Lin Zhixia takes it back, drops it in her pencil case, and never touches it again.

scenes.title: Replay · Score Night
scenes.summary: On NAC score night, Lin Zhixia sees 669. Zhou Yu sees 487. Shen Man scores only 330 and posts about it in the class group chat.
scenes.text: NAC score night. Lin Zhixia logs in, enters her contestant number. The screen flashes: 669 — exactly what she estimated. She stares for a few seconds, refreshes. Still 669. Her phone rings. Zhou Yu's voice is shaking: "Zhixia, I got 487. But I estimated around 330!" Lin Zhixia grips the phone, slowly smiles — then stops mid-smile. Meanwhile, the class group chat explodes: Shen Man posts a screenshot of her NAC score — "330. How is this possible?" The comments go silent for a long time. Someone finally asks carefully: "Man, did they make a mistake?" Shen Man doesn't reply.

scenes.title: Zhou Yu's Score
scenes.summary: Zhou Yu's score review is denied. She confronts Lin Zhixia. Shen Man barges in and blurts out "You only had 330!" — exposing that she knew the original score. Lin Zhixia admits she deliberately lent Zhou Yu's pen to Shen Man. Zhou Yu leaves in fury.
scenes.text: The next day, Zhou Yu rushes into Lin Zhixia's house, eyes red: "I filed a score review with the NAC Committee. They said my 487 is correct. But I estimated around 330!" Before Lin Zhixia can speak, Shen Man pushes through the door. She snatches Zhou Yu's phone, sees 487, and blurts out: "You only had 330!" Zhou Yu fires back: "Scores just came out. How do you know what I had before?" Shen Man's face changes. She slams the phone down and storms out. Zhou Yu turns to Lin Zhixia: "Zhixia, do you know something?" A long silence. Then Lin Zhixia speaks: "That pen. The one she borrowed — it was yours." Zhou Yu freezes: "What pen?" "Before the final NAC test, she borrowed a pen. I handed her yours." Zhou Yu's face slowly changes: "You did it on purpose?" Lin Zhixia doesn't deny it. "So you protected yourself and pushed me out there instead?" Lin Zhixia: "I didn't think it would go this way. I thought she was swapping—" "You thought? That was my NAC score. What do you mean, you thought?" The door slams. Lin Zhixia sits in the dark. She doesn't turn on the light for a long time.

scenes.title: The Rooftop · Closing the Net
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia confronts Shen Man on the rooftop, threatening her with the offline backup. Shen Man lunges, hits the railing. Police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song arrive.
scenes.text: That night, Shen Man calls. Her voice trembles: "It was you. You switched my pen." Lin Zhixia: "I didn't switch anything. I just didn't lend you mine." "Do you know how long I prepared for this?!" "Zhou Yu prepared longer." Three seconds of silence. "You're dead." The next night, 8 PM. The rooftop. Lin Zhixia goes. A sports camera is clipped to her backpack strap. A recorder is hidden in her sleeve. Zhou Yu waits in the stairwell — not to help her, but to hear Shen Man admit the swap with her own ears. To get her score back. Shen Man comes up holding a pen: "You know what this is? The moment I write your name—" "Write it." Lin Zhixia cuts her off. "You swapped Zhou Yu once. Swap me again, and that's two entries in the log. You can delete the server, but you can't delete the offline backup. You have one choice left: admit the swap. Give Zhou Yu her score back." Shen Man lunges. Lin Zhixia sidesteps. Shen Man can't stop herself and slams into the railing. Footsteps thunder up the stairwell — police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song, the technician the Shen family fired, holding printouts of the system log.

scenes.title: The Log
scenes.summary: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia found Old Song. He showed her the Easy-Swap system log: borrower Shen Man, lender Zhou Yu, swap successful — plus a note: "Wrong target. Recommend rollback." Zhou Yu learns the system marked her as "recommended ignore."
scenes.text: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia knocked on Old Song's door. In her past life, during score week, a forum post from someone claiming to be inside the scoring system was deleted within seconds. She memorized the ID. This time, she followed the trail. Old Song spreads the printouts on the table: an unsigned anomaly module, codename "Easy-Swap." Two fields: "Borrower: Shen Man. Lender: Zhou Yu. Swap result: Success." Three days later, a new line appears: "Wrong target. Recommend rollback." Lin Zhixia: "The system knows it swapped the wrong person." Old Song: "The system isn't stupid. It just doesn't care." Zhou Yu stands in the doorway, voice barely audible: "So my score was marked 'recommended ignore'?" Old Song says nothing. He slides the USB drive across the table.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.summary: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues the system doesn't exist. The prosecution submits three pieces of evidence. The judge asks Shen Man why her first reaction was to call Lin Zhixia instead of filing a score review.
scenes.text: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues: "This so-called system doesn't exist." The prosecution submits three things: Old Song's offline log, the rooftop recording, and a screenshot of Shen Man's post from score night. In court, the judge asks Shen Man: "You saw 487. Your first reaction was to call Lin Zhixia — not to file a score review with the NAC Committee. Why?" Shen Man opens her mouth. Nothing comes out. Lin Zhixia sits in the gallery. She doesn't look at her.

scenes.title: The Reckoning
scenes.summary: Official notice: Shen Man arrested, her father investigated for bribery, Shen Group bankrupt. The Easy-Swap system is handed to investigators. Zhou Yu's score is restored — but the friendship can't be.
scenes.text: Official notice: Shen Man used an unidentified "Easy-Swap system" to illegally swap NAC score data. Charged with unauthorized modification of computer systems and attempted murder. Arrest approved. Her father is investigated for paying three million to buy off the score review. The bribery chain is exposed. Shen Group stock drops for seven straight days, the bank calls in its loans, and the company declares bankruptcy. The origin of the "Easy-Swap system" is unknown. It has been handed to a special investigative body. Zhou Yu's NAC score is restored based on her actual exam paper. The day her admission letter arrives, she sends Lin Zhixia a message: "My score is back. But we can't go back." Lin Zhixia stares at the screen for a long time. She replies with one word: "Yeah."

scenes.title: Epilogue
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia receives her admission letter. She and Zhou Yu message each other about their majors. She keeps Zhou Yu's pen as a warning.
scenes.text: The day Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives, her mother wipes the envelope three times before daring to open it. Her phone lights up. A message from Zhou Yu: "I'm going into teaching. So no one can ever swap a student's score again." Lin Zhixia smiles and types back: "I'm going into law." "Why?" "Because the system is still out there. Someone has to watch it." She places the pen — Zhou Yu's pen — under the glass on her desk. Beside it, a sticky note: "This time, every point is mine. Next time, no one takes them." But she doesn't throw the pen away. The system didn't disappear. It just changed its shape — waiting for the next person who lends a pen.
